keySentence: Everyone was afraid to tell the simple truth.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Thousands of people watched. They all knew the truth. But fear stopped them. Everyone was afraid to tell the simple truth.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The whole kingdom watched the emperor march through town. Thousands of people lined the streets and stayed silent. Everyone was afraid to tell the simple truth to the emperor. They thought they would be called foolish if they spoke. The swindlers had tricked the entire kingdom with one lie. But one small voice was about to change everything.
facts.Word cards: tricked = 속였다 / emperor = 임금님 / fake = 가짜 / invisible = 보이지 않는 / lied = 거짓말했다
